title: Command output renders through ⎿ and its first row's columns are shifted
observed: /status prints '  ⎿  model      faux/faux-1' then '  auth       configured', '  tier ...': the ⎿ prefix is only on the first row, so the first key/value pair sits 2 columns right of the rest and the value column zig-zags. The output hangs off the you block with no label of its own.
expected: Command output as a design block: a one-line 'system' note, or a labelled block (e.g. 'status ───') with the key/value rows aligned in one grid; no ⎿ (not in the design set).
design_ref: plan restyle item: bridge.go CommitCommandResult; Terminal.dc.html system note
